# PANTONE+ Solid Coated reference values

`pantone-plus-solid-coated.json` maps PANTONE+ Solid Coated names to approximate sRGB values (1,340 colors).
Extracted from the `pantone-p-solid-coated` book in [color2library](https://github.com/matedon/color2library) 1.0.8 (MIT, matedon.com).

Logo Pack uses it only to *suggest* the closest Pantone for each brand color (CIEDE2000).
Screen values of spot colors are approximations: always confirm a suggestion against a printed Pantone guide.
PANTONE® is a registered trademark of Pantone LLC.
